def transform(grid):
    from collections import Counter
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    counts=Counter(v for row in grid for v in row if v)
    if not counts:return [row[:] for row in grid]
    color=counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    pts=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c]==color]
    rs=Counter(r for r,c in pts);cs=Counter(c for r,c in pts)
    vertical=max(cs.values())>=max(rs.values())
    lo=min(c if vertical else r for r,c in pts)
    hi=max(c if vertical else r for r,c in pts)
    return [[v if v==color or lo<=(c if vertical else r)<=hi else 0 for c,v in enumerate(row)] for r,row in enumerate(grid)]
